name: part1
hook: 6,000 bosses were asked what AI did for them
post: Nearly nine in ten said: nothing. No change in productivity, no change in jobs (NBER, Feb 2026). This has happened before. Part 1 of 3. #ai #productivity #economics #history #electricity #business #work #tech #thecurve

name: part2
hook: Why electricity took decades to pay off
post: Factories swapped the steam engine for one big electric motor and changed nothing else. The gains came when they rebuilt around the motor. Part 2 of 3. #ai #productivity #economics #history #electricity #business #work #tech #thecurve

name: part3
hook: AI is stuck at the one-big-motor stage
post: "You can see the computer age everywhere but in the productivity statistics" (Solow, 1987). 95% of company AI pilots made no measurable return (MIT, 2025). Part 3 of 3. #ai #productivity #economics #history #electricity #business #work #tech #thecurve

name: nothing
hook: AI changed nothing for 9 in 10 companies. So far.
post: An NBER survey of about 6,000 executives in the US, UK, Germany and Australia (Feb 2026): nearly 90% saw no change in productivity or jobs from AI. The bosses who used it averaged 1.5 hours a week. #ai #productivity #economics #history #electricity #business #work #tech #thecurve

name: shaft
hook: The mistake every factory made with electricity
post: Old factories ran on one steam engine turning one long shaft, with belts to every machine. Owners swapped in one big electric motor and changed nothing else. Same shaft, same belts, small savings. #ai #productivity #economics #history #electricity #business #work #tech #thecurve

name: redesign
hook: The redesign that finally made electricity pay
post: A small motor in every machine, laid out along the flow of the work. By 1920 half of US factory power was electric, and productivity surged (Paul David, 1990). #ai #productivity #economics #history #electricity #business #work #tech #thecurve

name: pilots
hook: Why 95% of company AI pilots don't pay
post: MIT's 2025 study: 95% of company AI pilots made no measurable return. Mostly bolted onto the old routine. The tool is rarely the bottleneck. The layout is. #ai #productivity #economics #history #electricity #business #work #tech #thecurve

name: office
hook: What an office built from zero around AI loses first
post: Not a forecast, a what-if: the weekly status meeting, the inbox, the jobs that only move information from one place to another. #ai #productivity #economics #history #electricity #business #work #tech #thecurve
